versions.changelog:
Initial release of jadwal-sholat.

- Fetches daily, specific-date, or monthly prayer times for any city/regency in Indonesia using api.myquran.com (sumber Kemenag Bimas Islam).
- Includes helper script for searching locations and retrieving schedules.
- Supports keyword search for cities, with logic for exact or best matches.
- Provides curl examples for direct API access.
- Documents how to obtain city/regency IDs for targeted queries.
